messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Do not keep leftover tramadol. Just one dose can cause death if someone uses it accidentally or improperly. Ask your pharmacist where to locate a drug take-back disposal program. If there is no take-back program, mix the leftover medicine with cat litter or coffee grounds in a sealed plastic bag and throw the bag in the trash.
Call your healthcare provider if the dose you are taking does not control your pain.
If you have been taking tramadol regularly, do not stop taking tramadol without talking to your healthcare provider.
Triplet: ["tramadol", "has overdose risk", "one dose can cause death"]

The relation 'has overdose risk' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug poses a significant danger where a small amount, as specified by the object, can lead to fatal consequences if misused or accidentally ingested.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has warning': The subject drug carries a safety warning or precaution about the risk or situation specified by the object entity.
B. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
C. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
D. 'has overdose symptom': An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
E. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
